walking_rule: continuous movement begins on the explicit walking acknowledgement; unlabelled transitions excluded
return_rule: empty return begins on explicit out acknowledgement; full phase and time after 5-second transition both reported
requirements: fresh human empty-room confirmation before firmware maintenance
full current 16MB backup/reverification before test image
always restore current firmware, verify flash hash, fresh supervisor and advancing real TLS video
limitations: One walking bout and empty-return interval do not establish zone coverage, seated presence, sensitivity or general accuracy.
Human reply and polling times do not identify exact physical movement onset.
Scalar phase reports are correlated observations, not independent trials.
coordination_change: Only human handoff waiting increases from 60 to 120 seconds; firmware, frozen threshold policy, 60-second measurement phases and 590-second overall bound are unchanged.
chat_instruction: Keep this chat visible while outside and reply within two minutes after each explicit movement cue.
late_walking_reply_policy: Never backdate a late reply or relabel the preceding incomplete capture.
